## Dispatch — `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), round R33

Claimed: objectstack-ai/objectui#9294 — dispatched to an `os-dev` seat by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) at R33.
Clause-②: yes

### ⛔ The triage comment on this card is **BINDING** — read it in full first (rule 38)
It carries a **corrected count**, the ruled direction, the one genuinely open choice, and a six-point acceptance whose first line is methodological. This dispatch does not restate it and does not override it. Where they differ, it wins.

### ⭐ Premise re-verified at this seat before dispatch (rule 52)
Read on `origin/main` just now — **seven** locale-less call sites live, and the parent's repair is in place as the lit control:

```
:311  value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })   ← percent-of-rows
:314  value.toLocaleString()
:327  new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, {                              ← currency
:333  new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, {                              ← currency (other branch)
:338  value.toLocaleString()
:373  value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })   ← avg
:375  value.toLocaleString()
--- and the control ---
:371  formatted = formatPercent(value, decimals, displayLocale);      ← objectui#9269, LANDED
```

### ⚠️ The count: **seven call sites, not four**
The card says "four arms"; triage counted **seven call sites** — one arm can have several branches. ⛔ Neither is wrong; they count different things. **Cover seven.**

### ⭐ The harm, and why it is worse than its parent card
```
                    currency     plain
de-DE (correct)     1.235 €      1.234,5
machine(undefined)  €1,235       1,234.5     ← what renders today
```
⇒ **a `de-DE` tenant reads `1,234.5`, parses it by German convention as 1.2345 — off by a factor of 1000 — and it is a CURRENCY TOTAL.**

⭐ Sharper than objectui#9269's percent-sign move: **a sign changing sides is visible; a decimal separator changing is not.** `1,234.5` is a perfectly legal German number — just three orders of magnitude out.

⭐ And this repo has paid for this exact sentence once already: `packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts:261` records *"it is the MACHINE's locale. A German session read a KPI as …"*, while `useDisplayLocale`'s own doc comment names it as **the one thing a caller must not do**. ⇒ this card is an uncovered instance of an **already-written** discipline, ⛔ not a new rule.

### ⭐ Direction is ruled; the ROUTE is yours, and one route has a precondition
- **Direction ⛔ not a decision**: route these calls through the concrete locale `useDisplayLocale()` yields. That is pulling back to a contract this repo already declares (*"Every date, number and currency renderer goes through here for exactly that reason"*).
- **The open choice is implementation, not product**: thread the locale into the existing `Intl` calls **vs** move these arms onto `@object-ui/fields`' `formatCurrency` / `formatNumber`. ⚠️ The card itself notes the second route *"may have its own rendered-output consequences that need measuring first"* ⇒ ⭐ **if you take it, MEASURE FIRST and show a before/after rendering comparison in the PR.** ⛔ Do not fold a wider change in as incidental. Triage deliberately did not choose for you.

### ⭐⭐ The acceptance line that matters most is a method, not a target
> **Read the rows, not the cells.**

⇒ assert that **currency / plain / avg / percent-of-rows outputs MOVE when the tenant locale moves**, and keep the **percent column as the lit control** — it is already fixed, so it moving proves your fixture is really changing the locale. ⛔ Do not write per-cell snapshots; a snapshot suite passes while measuring nothing about the locale channel.
- Cover at least **`de-DE` and `tr-TR`** (both swap `,` / `.`), and ⛔ the **currency arm must be in it**.
- ⭐ **Ablation leg:** put any one call site back to `undefined` — its row must stop tracking the tenant locale and the pin must redden.

### ⛔ Boundaries
- ⛔ **Do not touch the percent arm** — objectui#9269 landed it (PR objectui#9293) and it is your control.
- ⛔ **Do not touch objectui#4589's number-display policy ownership.**

### Standing constraints for this round
- Read `AGENTS.md` in full before your first edit. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**/*.tsx` is a **No-Touch zone** (Commandment #7).
- ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine a test. ⛔ Never force-push or rewrite pushed history.
- **Changeset required.** 41 packages in ONE `fixed` group ⇒ `major` unavailable; breaking ships as `minor` with a `**BREAKING**` carrier. Justify by **measurement**. ⚠️ Rendered output moves in every session whose browser locale differs from the tenant's — say so.
- ⚠️ There is **no npm script matching `no-major`**; the file runs inside **`changeset:check`**. A `254 Command not found` on another spelling is **NOT MEASURED, not a red gate**.
- objectui has **no** `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`; derive the gate family by hand from `package.json` + `.github/workflows/`.
- ⚠️ **A package-scoped run is not the blast radius** (objectui#9273). Rendered strings move ⇒ run `examples/schema-catalog/` and grep count-shaped and prose figures repo-wide.
- ⚠️⚠️ **A declared narrowing of your verification union can still be the load-bearing one.** This lane just paid for it: a seat excluded `@object-ui/site` as "a docs app", and `apps/site` both declares `type-check` **and** depends on the package under change — CI went red exactly there. ⭐ Before trusting any exclusion, do a **membership read** of the dependent set plus a look at the excluded package's own `scripts`.
- ⚠️ **Install/build first.** A missing `node_modules` makes every `require.resolve` fail identically — **instrument failure, not a negative answer**. Read verdicts from the verify-lock wrapper's VERDICT line, never a bare `$?`.
- ⚠️ **Carrier rule (directional):** hang `needs:contract-review` on **both** limbs in one stroke. ⛔ **Never clear either limb**; clearing is the PM's. (REST label POST needs `Content-Type: application/json`, else **415** — ⛔ not a permission failure.)
- ⚠️ **In flight:** objectui#9274 (`app-shell` inspectors, p1), objectui#9304 (`plugin-detail`, `plugin-form`), and PR objectui#9310 (`packages/react`, `packages/fields`, `apps/site`) which is open and **held**. ⚠️ **#9310 touches `packages/fields`** — if you take the shared-formatter route you land there too. ⛔ Check before editing it.
- ⚠️ **Dedup:** ⭐ this card's own dedup is the most complete this lane has seen (full open-set enumeration reconciled against `open_issues_count`, controls lit both ways, the closed half declared unmeasured). You need one only for anything **new** you find.
- ⛔ No model identifier in any pushed artifact; ⛔ don't copy a neighbouring commit's trailer — use the model-free form. ⛔ Card relations belong in the **PR body**, not the commit message.

### ⭐ The two instrument standards this seat holds
1. **Write the pin BEFORE the code** — the "unmodified" arm is then the real base tree.
2. **Every control must be able to fire.** ⭐ Here the percent column is the lit control **precisely because it was already fixed**: if it does not move when your fixture moves the locale, your fixture is not moving the locale and every other row is **NOT MEASURED**, ⛔ not a negative answer.
